title: Cursor vs Lovable: AI Code Editor vs AI App Builder — Different Jobs, Different People
summary: Cursor is a code editor. Lovable is a frontend generator. Both require you to wire up your own database, auth, and hosting. Blink is the third option where the whole stack is included.
body_markdown: At face value, Cursor Pro ($20/mo) and Lovable Pro ($25/mo) are close in price. The real difference is in total cost to a shipped app. Cursor users building a new product also need Supabase, Vercel, and an auth service — bringing the realistic total to $70–90/mo minimum. Lovable includes the Supabase backend, so the sticker price is closer to the actual cost.[Blink](https://blink.new/) 's Starter plan at $25/mo includes everything — database, auth, storage, hosting, and custom domain — on one bill, making it the lowest true total-cost option for most use cases.
